remarks:
MOTIVATED SELLERS 
Imagine pulling into your driveway after a long day, greeted by a fresh front porch and the crisp breeze of Lake Erie. Located just minutes from Evangola State Park, this stunning 3,300 sq. ft. lakefront home offers the ultimate waterfront lifestyle.

As you step inside the open-concept first floor, your eyes are immediately drawn past the elegant slate flooring and the cozy wood-burning fireplace straight to the panoramic water views. The seamless flow from the kitchen and dining area to the living space makes entertaining a dream. Through the sliding glass doors lies a massive, wraparound stamped concrete patio—your front-row seat to spectacular, unobstructed west-facing sunsets. Downstairs also features an oversized bedroom boasting warm hardwood flooring and a charming bay window framing the lake.

Upstairs, the views only get grander. Hardwood floors guide you through light-filled spaces, including a versatile third bedroom (a rare bonus not reflected in standard 2-bedroom tax records) featuring its own private, lakeside balcony. The luxurious primary suite is a true sanctuary, complete with floor-to-ceiling windows and a private balcony overlooking the water. A second-floor laundry room and a charming wood-burning stove add effortless comfort to daily living.

Peace of mind is built right into the property with a narrative of meticulous care. Enjoy a new sidewalk equipped with ice-melt system infrastructure, a new fence, a new shed powered with electric service, and a brand-new boiler system.

Whether you are seeking a permanent year-round residence or a peaceful waterfront retreat, this Lake Erie masterpiece delivers an unforgettable setting you'll want to call home.
